FOREWORD This Indian Standard was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards, after the draft finalized by the Pesticides Sectional Committee had been approved by the Food and Agriculture Division Council. In the preparation of this standard, due consideration has been given to the provisions of the Insecticides Ac[, 1968 and the Rules framed thereunder. However this standard is subject to the restrictions imposed under the Act and Rules, wherever applicable. For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test or analysis, shall be rounded off in accordance with IS 2:1960 `Rules for rounding off numerical values (revised)'. The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard.

Indian Standard GLUFOSINATE AMMONIUM TEC13NICAL CONCENTRATE -- SPECIFICATION
1 SCOPE This standard prescribes the requirements and the methods of sampling and test for glufosinate ammonium technical concentrate. 2 REFERENCES The following Indian Standards contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated below: [S No. 1070: {992 6940:1982 8190 (Part 2): 1988 10946: }996 Title Reagent grade water (third revision) Methods of test for pesticides and their formulations @-st revision) Requirement for packing of pesticides: Part 2 Liquid pesticides (second revision) Methods of sampling for technical grade pesticides (/irst revision) 4 PACKING The material shall be packed as per requirements given in IS 8190 (Part 2). The material shall be packed in HDPE barrels of 200 Iitres capacity. 5 MARICING 5.1 The container shall be securely closed and shall bear legibly and indelibly the following in addition to any other information as is necessary under the Insecticides Act, 1968 and Rules framed thereunder: a) b) c) d) e) o g) h) Name of the material; Name and address of the manufacturer; Batch number; Date of manufacture; Date of expiry; Net mass of contents; Nominal value : Glufosinate content, percent mlm; and ammonium

3 REQUIREMENTS 3.1 Description The material shall be of colorless to light brown colour clear liquid, free from sediment and/or suspended matter with slight pungent odour. 3.2 The material shall also comply with the requirements given in Table 1. ANNEX A [Table 1, S1 No. (i)]
DETERMINATION A-1 GENERAL A-1.1 High performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) method shall be used for the determination of glufosinate ammonium content in glufosinate ammonium technical concentrate. PERFORMANCE A-2 HIGH CHROMATOGRAPH A-2.1 Principle A high performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) unit with a variable ultra ~iolet (U. V.) detector is used for the determination. Using solutions containing known amounts of glufosinate ammonium reference standard, and sample containing unknown amount of glufosinate ammonium are injected to obtain respect ive peak areas. The percentage of glufosinate ammonium in the sample is computed by standard relationship. A-2.2 Apparatus A-2.2.1 HPLC Unit A suitable instrument equipped with a variable UV detector and a printer-plotter-cum-integrator. The HPLC conditions suggested below can be changed in equipment employed, provided standardization is done. A-2.2.2 Column -- Stainless steel, 12.5 cm long and 4.6 mm internal diameter packed with strongly basic anion exchanger on basis of silica, particle size 5 mm. A-2.2.3 Nucleosil equivalent. A-2.2.4 A-2.2.5 SB 5 -- Macherey and Nagel or LIQUID OF GLUFOSINATE AMMONIUM CONTENT water for HPLC use or

A-2.3.2 Water -- bidistilled equivalent.

A-2.3.3 Potassium Dihydrogenphosphate -- HPLC grade or equivalent. A-2.3.4 Mobile Phase and Make up Phase 0.1 mol/litre potassium dihydrogenphosph in bidistilled water. Filter and use. A-2.4 Standard Solution Preparation

(KH2P0,)

ate solution

Weigh accurately 50 mg (to the nearest 0.1 mg) of glufosinate ammonium reference standard of known puri~ in 25 ml volumetric flask. Dissolve in a small amount of make up phase and make up to the mark with make up phase. Homogenize. A-2.5 Sample Solution Preparation Weigh, accurately a mass of sample formulation equivalent to 50 mg (to nearest 0.1 mg) of glufosinate ammonium in 25 ml volumetric flask. Dissolve in a small amount of make up phase and make up to the mark with make up phase. Homogenize.
